lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  profile_tactic "h0" in
    have h0 : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (mt inner_self_eq_zero'.mp hx₀)
  profile_tactic "hc" in
    have hc : Continuous fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
      Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  profile_tactic "delta" in
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ : ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ x, dist x x₀ < δ → 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
      Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hc.continuousAt.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds h0))
  profile_tactic "letphi" in
    let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  profile_tactic "testfn" in
    have htf : IsTestFunction (fun x => φ x • f x₀) :=
      ⟨φ.contDiff.smul contDiff_const, φ.hasCompactSupport.smul_right⟩
  profile_tactic "hgapply" in
    have key := hg _ htf
  profile_tactic "simpcost" in
    simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  profile_tactic "hcp" in
    have hcp : Continuous fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := Continuous.mul φ.continuous hc
  profile_tactic "hnn" in
    have hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := fun x =>
      if h : dist x x₀ < δ then mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hball x h).le
        else by rw [φ.zero_of_le_dist (not_lt.mp h), zero_mul]
  profile_tactic "integrable" in
    have hi := hcp.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (μ := μ) φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right
  profile_tactic "hpos" in
    have hpos := integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero (μ := μ) hcp hi hnn
      (mul_ne_zero (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)).ne' h0.ne')
  exact hpos.ne' key
